definitions.gloss: lingering summer heat; late summer heat
definitions.explanation: the continued hot weather after the traditional end of summer, typically from mid-August through September

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}が{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: The lingering summer heat is severe.

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}お{見舞|みま}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: I send you my regards during the lingering summer heat.

examples.japanese: {残暑|ざんしょ}が{続|つづ}いて{体調|たいちょう}を{崩|くず}した。
examples.english: I got sick because the lingering summer heat continued.

notes:
SEASONAL VOCABULARY:
{残暑|ざんしょ} refers to the hot weather that continues after {立秋|りっしゅう} (the traditional start of autumn, around August 7-8) through September.

SEASONAL GREETING:
{残暑|ざんしょ}お{見舞|みま}い is a formal summer greeting card sent during this period. It replaces {暑中|しょちゅう}お{見舞|みま}い (summer greeting) after {立秋|りっしゅう}.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {残暑|ざんしょ}お{見舞|みま}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます - formal summer greeting (after {立秋|りっしゅう})
- {残暑|ざんしょ}が{厳|きび}しい - the lingering heat is severe
- {残暑|ざんしょ}の{候|こう} - during the lingering summer heat (formal letter)

TIME PERIOD:
{立秋|りっしゅう} (around August 7-8) through {秋分|しゅうぶん} (around September 23)

RELATED WORDS:
- {暑中|しょちゅう} - midsummer heat (before {立秋|りっしゅう})
- {猛暑|もうしょ} - intense heat
- {酷暑|こくしょ} - extreme heat
